{{Top|leg}}
A '''magna-seal''' was a security device that could be used to keep various things securely closed.<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref> Cargo crates could be sealed with magna-seals,<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> while [[Xufal D'uat]] adapted cabins in his ship, [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Venom Sting'']] with magna-seals to create cells. This customization was to the liking of later owners of the ship, a team of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].<ref name="SS" />
